hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each catalog member A_i is recovered as O_i[F], where F(t)=f(t); G0002 = derivative operator at x, and G0001 = first-order Newton divided difference on nodes x,y.
required_assumptions: f is differentiable at x so that df(x) is defined
x and y are distinct where the denominator x-y is non-zero
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0001 is the first divided difference of f on nodes x and y, while G0002 is the derivative of f at x. They share the same latent function F(t)=f(t) through derivative and Newton divided-difference operators, forming a derivative family instance rather than an exact identity.
